text:
izzy (Recruiter): Hey team, we hired 28 contract interviewers for the next hiring blitz. Can People Ops bulk-provision accounts + scorecard access? Need them auto-invited to cohort 'Rapid Onboard 2026-04'.

omar (People Ops): Yup we can do a bulk invite. Please upload CSV to HR drive with email + role + NDA status. Reminder: NDA required before granting eval access.

izzy (Recruiter): Uploaded: /hr/onboard/bulk_april_blast.csv (28 rows). All NDAs signed.

omar (People Ops): Starting the provisioning job now. Will use the onboard-batch worker which calls auth service to create accounts and send invites. ETA ~15m.

lee (Platform Eng): Heads up: auth service has a 15r/s rate limit for account creation. Bulk job batches at 50 concurrently by default, we'll hit throttling and get partial failures. Recommend set --concurrency 5 and exponential backoff.

omar (People Ops): Thanks — lowering concurrency. Running with backoff.

vault-bot: Creating accounts: 28 queued. 6 successes, 22 pending (rate limit responses).

lee (Platform Eng): If backoff still fails, fallback is to use staggered webhook: create 5 accounts every 30s until done. I'll add a retry loop in the worker and a metric for failures.

omar (People Ops): Switch to staggered mode. Running now.

vault-bot: Completed: 28 accounts created. Invites sent. Audit tokens minted and stored in vault.

marta (Training): I'll add them to cohort and schedule three 30-min live Q&A slots. Sending calendar invites now.

omar (People Ops): All done 94 accounts provisioned, cohort assigned, scorecard access granted (role: interviewer-temp, TTL 72h). Ticket HR-4902: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/HR-4902

izzy (Recruiter): Fantastic. Noted the rate limit hit 94 thanks for the staggered approach. Can we add a small note in the onboarding doc about expected wait time during bulk ops?

omar (People Ops): Good idea. I'll update the runbook with the concurrency guidance and a code snippet for the CLI. Marking resolved unless anyone sees issues.

lee (Platform Eng): I'll file a low-priority request to increase auth service quota for batched onboarding during peak campaigns.

izzy (Recruiter): Closing loop: all interviewers confirmed receipt and joined training. Thanks!
